phrase: A chip maker's former founder drew more than 100,000 signatures begging for his return. A new report says the same company engineered the shortage that made its chips so valuable.
phraseAlternatives: More than 100,000 people signed a petition for a chip maker's former founder to come back. The company stands accused of creating the very shortage that made it rich.
A chip maker's founder resigned, and over 100,000 people now want him reinstated. A report says his old company engineered the chip shortage that built its fortune.
Shareholders worth billions are begging a chip maker to bring back its founder. A new report claims the scarcity that made it famous was built on purpose.
A petition to bring back a chip maker's former founder passed 100,000 signatures today. Meanwhile, a report says his company engineered the very scarcity that made it so valuable.
alt: A chip company's former founder, briefcase in hand, walks away from the company's open door past a small crowd holding a sign reading BRING HIM BACK. A cutaway of the same building shows a hidden dial narrowing the pipe between a computer chip and a growing stack of coins.

brief.concept: A chip maker's former founder walks out the door past a crowd begging for his return, while hidden inside the same building a dial quietly narrows the pipe between its chips and its growing pile of coins.
brief.metaphor: A company turning a scarcity dial to keep demand high, even as the public pleads for the man who used to run it.
